navigation_visibility_hint: Image Generation, Generation Config and Settings always remain visible. Hiding another workspace does not clear its images or settings.
image_controls_disabled: Controls remain available. Import an image before generating.
image_generation_requires_source: Import a source image before generating.
transform_result_hint: The transformed image will appear here.
enhance_show_individual_hint: Adjust the underlying Strength and Noise values.
edit_image_number_to_generate: Set Number of Images to Generate (Set to 0 for continuous generation)
image_file_not_found: The original image file could not be found
remember_sequential_progress_hint: When disabled, every newly started generation begins from the first item
select_bracket_hint: Negative → decreased weight; Positive → increased weight
edit_cascaded_config_str_notice: Enter prompts to be picked, one line for each prompt
NAI_API_key_hint: Available on the NovelAI website: Settings → Account → Get Persistent API Token
drag_and_drop_image_notice: Drop image here or press to upload
custom_metadata_enabled: Embed fake metadata into generated images
proxy_settings_unset: Not set in app (uses system / VPN)
proxy_settings_notice_desktop: No proxy entry is needed on mobile. On desktop, use Auto-detect; leave this blank when using TUN mode.
proxy_settings_notice_mobile: Leave this blank when your mobile proxy app uses VPN / TUN mode. Enter a value only when the proxy app explicitly provides a local HTTP proxy port.
proxy_detect_not_found: No common local proxy port was detected; the current input was kept.
drop_to_read_metadata: Drop image here to read metadata
metadata_not_found: Metadata not found in imported image
slider_invalid_value: Enter a valid value within the allowed range.
slider_invalid_range: Enter a valid range with the start no greater than the end.
appbar_generation_interval: Waiting before the next image to reduce 429 errors...
restore_welcome_message_hint: Return to Image Generation and show the welcome message again.
welcome_message_markdown:
Welcome to {appName} 🥰 This is a free and open-source community fork of NAI CasRand.

If you are new to the app, [configure API and proxy settings](#jump_to_api_proxy_settings) first. If you are not sure how to use the app, read the [project guide](https://github.com/khkjdfkjhdsfakhds/CasRand-Forge#readme).

If you encounter unexpected behavior or have an improvement idea, file an [Issue](https://github.com/khkjdfkjhdsfakhds/CasRand-Forge/issues) in the CasRand Forge repository. The [original project](https://github.com/Exception0x0194/NAI-Generator-Flutter) was created by Exception0x0194.
vibe_transfer_section_tip: Vibe Transfer references for V4 / V4.5. Precise Reference is below. Both resource sets can remain saved, but only one can be enabled for generation.
vibe_cost_notice: Estimated extra cost: the first 4 Vibes are free; each additional Vibe costs 2 Anlas per generated image. Current estimate for {vibe_count} Vibes × {n_samples} image(s): {anlas} extra Anlas.
vibe_v4_page_tip: Add a normal PNG, JPG, or WebP reference directly. CasRand extracts the Vibe through NovelAI when generation starts. Existing .naiv4vibe, .naiv4vibebundle, and PNG files with embedded encodings remain supported.
precise_reference_page_tip: Add character, style, or character & style reference images for V4.5 models. Strength and Fidelity both default to 1.0 and use the 0.0–1.0 range.
precise_reference_add: Add Precise Reference image, or drag PNG/JPG/WebP here
precise_reference_v45_only: Precise Reference only supports V4.5 models. Select a V4.5 model in Generation Parameters first.
precise_reference_cost_notice: Estimated extra cost: each Precise Reference costs 5 Anlas per generated image. Current estimate for {reference_count} reference(s) × {n_samples} image(s): {anlas} extra Anlas.
precise_reference_vibe_conflict_notice: Both Vibe Transfer and Precise Reference images and settings remain saved. Generation uses only the currently enabled set; use the switches to change it.
output_file_name_prefix_hint:
Use `__key__` to import prompt content in file name

E.g. `portrait-__artstyle__` → `portrait-watercolor`
title: Title
saved_config_list_usage_tip: Use `__title between double underscores__` to use saved configs here
config_selection_page_hint: Tap & hold saved config to load
restore_initial_settings_hint: Restore the active configuration to the built-in defaults
restore_initial_settings_warning: The current prompts, characters, negative prompts, generation parameters, I2I, Vibe Transfer, and software options will be restored to their initial settings. Existing entries under Saved Configs will not be deleted or overwritten. Would you like to back up the current configuration first?
i2i_drop_hint: Tap to import, or drag and drop an image here
i2i_active_note: While a base image is set, every generation uses img2img / inpainting.
i2i_random_seed_hint: Overrides the fixed seed from Generation Parameters only for the Img2Img / Inpainting area. Text-to-image, Enhance, and all other tools keep their own seed behavior.
i2i_generate_once_started: Generation started. Check the Generation page for the result.
inpaint_mask_present: Mask painted: masked area will be repainted
inpaint_add_original_image_hint: Keep unmasked areas identical to the original image
inpaint_autocrop_hint_on: Frames focus inpainting for you: takes the largest frame centered on the mask, scales it to fill the request budget, then scales the result back and pastes it into the original. It only applies when the base image exceeds the free size (1,048,576 pixels).
inpaint_autocrop_hint_inactive: Autocrop stays enabled, but this base image is within the free size (1,048,576 pixels), so this request uses whole-image inpainting. Automatic framing starts above that size.
inpaint_autocrop_hint_off: Off: the whole image is scaled to the request size and repainted directly
mask_import_auto_uses_alpha: Transparency was detected, so Auto uses the alpha channel.
mask_import_auto_uses_luminance: No useful transparency was detected, so Auto uses perceptual brightness.
mask_import_alpha_hint: Lighter alpha values become repaint areas.
mask_import_no_alpha_hint: This image has no alpha channel; Alpha will behave as fully opaque.
mask_import_luminance_hint: Brighter pixels become repaint areas using perceptual color brightness.
mask_import_aspect_warning: The mask aspect ratio ({source}) differs from the base image ({target}); it will be stretched to fit.
mask_import_resize_notice: The mask will be resized from {source} to {target}.
mask_import_empty: The current conversion contains no repaint area.
mask_import_decode_failed: The mask image could not be read or converted.
mask_import_clipboard_no_image: The clipboard does not contain a usable image. The current mask was not changed.
api_proxy_settings_summary: Configure your NovelAI API Token and proxy; multiple APIs are optional
api_proxy_settings_summary_with_optional: Configure API and proxy settings; {count} optional API tokens added
api_tokens_optional_hint: Optional. Leave this unset for normal use; add tokens only when you want concurrent generation.
api_tokens_manage_hint: Add multiple NovelAI accounts' tokens; generation runs one parallel worker per enabled token.
api_tokens_empty_note: No token entries: the API key above is used alone.
api_tokens_concurrent_note: Each enabled token generates in parallel
api_tokens_parallel_hint: When off, only the API token from the main settings page is used. When on, tasks are assigned in the order below.
api_tokens_limit_note: {count}/6 accounts enabled. Up to 6 accounts can be enabled at once.
api_tokens_priority_note: Drag to set priority. The main token can be reordered or disabled, but can only be replaced or cleared in the parent API settings.
api_token_primary_delete_hint: Replace or clear the main token in the parent API settings
i2i_page_sections_hint: Import a base image to do img2img and inpainting in one place.
enhance_section_hint: Re-render the whole image with the official Enhance settings (1x refine or 1.5x magnification). Results can be sent here from the detail page.
enhance_drop_hint: Tap to import, or drop the image to Enhance here
enhance_started: Enhance started at {size}. The result will appear on this page.
enhance_clears_mask_notice: Enhance re-renders the whole image, so the current mask will be cleared.
enhance_too_large: The base image is too large for any Enhance amount.
action_use_as_base_done: Loaded as the Img2Img base image.
action_inpaint_done: Loaded for inpainting. Paint a mask to continue.
action_enhance_done: Sent to Enhance with the same prompt and seed.
director_tool_hint: Single-image tools, independent of the generation pipeline. Import a source image to begin.
director_tool_started: Running {tool}. The result will appear on this page.
director_tool_cost_value: This run costs about {anlas} Anlas. Background removal is the most expensive tool; cost scales with image size and Opus grants no free allowance here.
i2i_manual_size_hint: Enter the request width and height. Both sides snap to multiples of 64; values above the current official 3,145,728-pixel limit are scaled down proportionally.
inpaint_manual_frame_hint: Overrides Autocrop; only the masked area inside the frame is repainted
inpaint_manual_frame_hint_maskless: No mask painted: the whole area inside the Context Region will be repainted
mask_editor_frame_hint: Drag a rectangle to choose the repaint framing (maximum 1,048,576 pixels).
mask_editor_frame_set: Focus frame set. Drag again to replace it.
detail_shortcut_hint: ←/→ switch · Space to zoom · Esc to go back
prompt_mode_switch_to_fixed_effect: After switching, generation and every parameter page will use the independent fixed-prompt profile.
prompt_mode_switch_to_random_effect: After switching, generation and every parameter page will return to the independent random-prompt profile.
prompt_mode_profiles_preserved: The other profile will not be deleted or overwritten. Its prompts, character prompts, model, sizes, steps, sampler, seed mode, and all other generation settings remain intact.
do_not_ask_again: Do not show this confirmation again
prompt_mode_fixed_notice: Fixed-prompt mode is active. Generation now uses its separate prompts and parameters; switch back manually when needed.
prompt_mode_random_notice: Random-prompt mode is active. Generation now uses the random cascade and its separate parameters.
prompt_mode_fixed_active_hint: Positive, negative, character prompts, seed, model, sizes, and all generation parameters are isolated from the random profile.
fixed_positive_prompt_hint: This text is sent as-is without rolling a random cascade.
fixed_negative_prompt_hint: This text belongs only to the fixed profile.
fixed_character_positive_hint: Fixed positive prompt for this character
fixed_character_negative_hint: Fixed negative prompt for this character
confirm_prompt_mode_switch_hint: Turn this back on after choosing “Do not show again” if you want the full warning dialog restored.
action_enhance_fixed_mode_done: Sent to Enhance. The complete generation parameters were imported into the fixed profile, which is now active.
resource_ready: Resource ready; disabling it keeps the image and settings
advanced_feature_conflict_kept: Enabled {enabled} and disabled {disabled}. The disabled feature's images and settings remain intact.
actual_cost_detected: Detected actual consumption for this run: {anlas} Anlas. Concurrent use of the same account on another device may be included in the balance difference.
actual_cost_unavailable: Generation succeeded, but actual consumption could not be read.
donation_dialog_message: 🙏🏻 No, better chip in for some tokens.. They burn too fast...
vibe_add_reference: Add a Vibe reference image or Vibe file, or drag it here
vibe_encoding_ready: Encoding ready for the current model and extraction value
vibe_encoding_pending: Will be extracted when generation starts (2 Anlas)
vibe_encoding_unavailable: No image or compatible encoding for the current model
vibe_encoding_cost_notice: {count} reference image(s) need a new encoding for the current model and Information Extracted value. NovelAI charges 2 Anlas per extraction; estimated extraction cost: {anlas} Anlas. Extraction starts only when you generate.
vibe_encoding_model_unavailable: An encoded-only Vibe does not support the current model. Import its original image or a matching .naiv4vibe file.
navigation_directory_hint: Click a function to open it temporarily; use its switch to pin it to the Home screen, and drag to reorder.
navigation_description_generation: Create images from random or fixed prompts.
navigation_description_config: Edit cascade configs and generation parameters.
navigation_description_settings: Manage application preferences and account settings.
navigation_description_i2i: Use an image as the base or repaint selected areas.
navigation_description_reference: Guide composition and style with reference images.
navigation_description_enhance: Upscale or refine a generated image.
navigation_description_director: Open Director Tools with a source image.
inpaint_autocrop_too_many_tiles: AutoCrop needs {count} Focus requests, above the safe maximum of {max}. Reduce or merge the painted regions.
inpaint_autocrop_planning_failed: AutoCrop could not plan these painted regions. Adjust the mask or disable AutoCrop.
